Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the open-engine repo (the sales department). Do NOT git commit/branch/push/stash. No MCP, no network, no model calls, no skills; fixture-only tests with INVENTED contacts. NEVER execute scripts/gap_sync.py in any form. NEVER read *.env/*secret*/*token*/*key*/*credential* files. SANDBOX BOUNDARY: your session CANNOT read, list, import, or execute ANY path outside this worktree — /mnt/d_drive/repos/loop-factory and /mnt/d_drive/repos/hubspot-daily-2 are blocked; do NOT attempt them and do NOT ask for approval (nobody is watching). Every contract you need is stated in full below.

RUNS-V2 RECORD CONTRACT (vendor it — do not import cross-repo): a runs-v2 row is one JSON object per line appended to departments/sales/state/runs-v2.jsonl with EXACTLY these fields (any unknown field is invalid): schema='run-record/v2' (str, exact); rev (int); run_id (str, 'YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ-'+8 hex chars); department='sales' (str); node (str = stage name); epoch (int); ts (str, UTC ISO-8601); attempt (int); round (int|null); release (null or {hash:str, source_ref:str} — exactly those keys); trigger (null or {kind:str one of time|event|goal|manual|escalation, id:str, dedupe_key:str}); engine (str|null); model (str|null); auth_class (one of 'oauth_cli','service_oauth','local_model','blocked', or null); usage (null or {input_tokens:int, output_tokens:int, cache_read:int, cache_creation:int} — exactly those keys); cost (null or {lane:str 'flat_subscription'|'metered_forbidden', model_calls:int}); duration_ms (int|null); status (str, one of ok|blocked|error|halted|killed|escalated|skipped); errors (list); artifacts (list — reference the signed receipt id string here); receipts (list); evaluator (dict|null); approval (dict|null); external_actions_taken (int, always 0 here). Optional field 'promotion' (dict) exists in the contract but is stamped by the runner — your emitter never writes it. If cost.lane=='metered_forbidden', the validator marks derived metered_violation=true. Type rules: ints must not be bools; the record must be JSON-serializable. Your vendored src/factory/runrecord_v2.py implements build_record/validate_record/append to THIS exact contract, and your tests validate emitted rows against YOUR vendored validator.

VOICE GATE CONTRACT (do NOT read the real file — the contract is complete here): the production gate lives at /mnt/d_drive/repos/hubspot-daily-2/scripts/voice_gate.py. Python API: check_draft(body, *, channel, subject=None, metadata=None) -> {pass: bool, defects: [{rule_id, severity, detail}], warns: [...], rule_version, content_hash}. CLI: python3 <gate_path> --body-file FILE --channel email [--subject S] [--metadata-json J] --receipt-out OUT; exit 0=pass, 1=blocked, 2=gate error; receipts are PII-free. ADAPTER REQUIREMENT: the gate script path is configurable (env var SALES_VOICE_GATE_PATH, else a module-level default constant of that absolute path); invoke via subprocess by path. Missing gate file, exit code 2, unexpected exception, timeout, or malformed receipt => FAIL CLOSED: emit a blocked_voice_gate receipt (PII-free), no approval counting, no dispatch; drafting itself may continue. GATE TESTS: never invoke the real absolute path — from each test, write a tiny fake gate script into tmp_path (variants: exits 0 with pass receipt; exits 1 with a defect; exits 2) and point the adapter at it via SALES_VOICE_GATE_PATH; plus a missing-path case proving fail-closed.

MISSION — three gaps from an approved adapt plan (G2, G4, G5), smallest-adaptation, shadow-only, existing receipts stay authoritative: (G2) runs-v2 sidecar — read the sales receipts_spine at departments/sales/runtime/receipts_spine.py (inside this worktree; see how stages emit); add the vendored src/factory/runrecord_v2.py emitter + wire receipts_spine so each stage ALSO appends one valid runs-v2.jsonl row (department sales, node=stage name, status, duration, external_actions_taken=0, no bodies/contacts) referencing the signed receipt id in artifacts[]; the stage fails if the sidecar append fails. (G4) objectives emitter — add a deterministic script src/factory/objectives_observed_sales.py computing from AGGREGATE receipt/state data only (no contact rows): stale_opportunities count, qa_pass_rate, median_disposition_hours, closure_integrity — writing departments/sales/state/objectives_observed.json {schema:'objectives-observed/v1', ts, values:{...}} atomically; values it cannot compute are ABSENT never 0; wire into sales_daily.sh after the existing stages. (G5) voice-gate adapter — find where sales-reactivation drafts copy (look in departments/sales/runtime/, e.g. sales_loop.py / linkedin_reply.py); wire the gate (channel email) fail-closed exactly as stated in the contract above.

OWNED: the new files + receipts_spine.py + sales_daily.sh + the drafting-site file + tests/test_sales_v2_bridge.py (>=8 fixture tests: sidecar row validates against vendored contract; stage fails on sidecar failure; objectives absent-vs-zero; gate blocks bad copy fail-closed incl. missing-gate and exit-2; daily script wiring lines present). Create NO other files (no scratch scripts — run ad-hoc checks via python3 -c or in tests). Write ./evidence.md (sites found, diffs summary, test output). VERIFY: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_sales_v2_bridge.py -q -p no:cacheprovider, plus any existing suite for touched files.

FILE PLACEMENT (strict, matches the check): new emitter at src/factory/runrecord_v2.py; objectives script at src/factory/objectives_observed_sales.py; tests at tests/test_sales_v2_bridge.py; you may edit departments/sales/runtime/{receipts_spine.py,sales_daily.sh,sales_loop.py,linkedin_reply.py}; nothing else.
